name: dumbbell single power clean
description: Explosively pull one dumbbell from the floor to your shoulder. It builds power through the hips and legs.
instructions: Stand over a dumbbell with feet hip-width apart.
Hinge down and grip it with a flat back.
Explode up through your hips and shrug.
Pull the dumbbell up and catch it at your shoulder.
Lower it back down under control, then switch arms.
